data.name: Backup_Error_ConnectionStringNotSupported
data.value: This connection carries a full connection string, which a backup job cannot honour: pg_dump is configured from the host, port, user and database fields only and never reads the connection string. Clear the connection string and set those fields instead.

data.name: Restore_Error_ConnectionStringNotSupported
data.value: This connection carries a full connection string, which a restore job cannot honour consistently: the target database is inspected and cleared through the connection string, but pg_restore is configured from the host, port, user and database fields. Restoring in this state could inspect and clear one server while writing the data to another. Clear the connection string and set those fields instead.
